mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, program_id, member_id, identity_type, identity_source, identity_value, normalized_value, verified, is_primary, status, effective_from, effective_to, created_at, updated_at FROM loyalty.member_identity WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND program_id = #{programId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loyalty.member_identity (id, tenant_id, program_id, member_id, identity_type, identity_source, identity_value, normalized_value, verified, is_primary, status, effective_from) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{programId}, #{memberId}, #{type}, #{source}, #{value}, #{normalized}, #{verified}, #{isPrimary}, 'ACTIVE', now())
mapper.update: UPDATE loyalty.member_identity SET status = 'REVOKED', effective_to = #{now}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
